But **test gap is top-quartile with no test file at all**, so nothing will catch a regression; the refactor has to ship with a test. Current file, for reference (`src/Card.tsx:9-31`): one `

`s (720px main + 240px sidebar) — an intended two-column card whose layout, theme, and interaction are all encoded as literals in one place. --- ## 1. Design Token Escape (`crime_00002`, low, confidence 0.75) > Evidence: `9 hard-coded style values across 4 kinds (color, px, rgb, shadow)` — `#ff00aa`, `#0a0a0a`, `#cccccc`, `#1a73e8`, `rgb(0, 0, 0)` … The repo already has the token source of truth — `tailwind.config.ts` defines `brand`, `surface`, `ink`. None of the nine literals in `Card.tsx` come from it. That is the actual agent risk here: the next agent extending this file copies `#ff00aa` forward, and the token scale silently stops being the source of truth. Worth being honest about the mismatch: **the existing scale can't absorb all nine values.** `brand`/`surface`/`ink` cover background, surface, and body text. There is no token for the border (`#cccccc`), the muted sidebar text (`#666666`), the focus ring (`#1a73e8`), or the shadow. So the fix is two-sided — extend the scale, *then* consume it: ```ts // tailwind.config.ts — the scale grows to cover what Card actually needs export default { theme: { colors: { brand: "#0050ff", surface: "#f7f7fa", ink: "#111111", "ink-muted": "#666666", border: "#cccccc", focus: "#1a73e8", }, extend: { boxShadow: { card: "0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.24)" }, spacing: { card: "1.5rem" }, // was padding: 24 maxWidth: { card: "64rem" }, // was maxWidth: 1024 }, }, }; ``` Note `#ff00aa` is deliberately *not* preserved — it's a fixture-grade magenta with no token equivalent; the card background becomes `bg-surface`. That's a visual change and needs a design sign-off, which is exactly the conversation the finding is meant to force. Then the component holds zero raw values: ```tsx className="bg-surface text-ink border border-border shadow-card p-card outline-focus" ``` ## 2.
